item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 11:47 PM, 20 October 2026(Tuesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Samal, Orani, Bagac, and Abucay), Bulacan (Hagonoy and Calumpit), Cavite (Ternate and Naic), Pampanga (Macabebe, Masantol, Porac, Bacolor, San Fernando, Angeles, Santo Tomas, Apalit, and Mabalacat), Quezon (Tagkawayan, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Guinayangan, and General Nakar), Tarlac (Capas and Bamban), and Zambales (Subic, Castillejos, San Marcelino, San Narciso, San Felipe, Botolan, Cabangan, and Olongapo) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bataan (Morong), Pampanga (Floridablanca, Lubao, Guagua, Santa Rita, Sasmuan, and Minalin), and Zambales (San Antonio) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
